Role: Conversational AI Developer
Industry: Information Services
Company size: 501-1,000 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I've been using Bamboo HR for internal purposes to filter relevant candidates for hiring. It's super easy to use, and track candidates with skills required for the particular job opening hence making it very easy for the team to shortlist relevant candidates and save time.
Cons: The UI of BambooHR can be improved to provide a better use experience to the users.

Role: Executive Assistant
Industry: Computer Software
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I like the fact that you can implement Bamboo with as little as 2 employees, and it grows with you and your needs.
Cons: You can't enroll without speaking to a representative. It'd be great if everything was electronic.

Role: Software Engineer
Industry: Accounting
Company size: 501-1,000 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 3
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: There is not much I need to do in it, the program mainly displays information.
Cons: A bit hard to navigate as it isn't used regularly, and with so many programs it is hard to know what to use it for.

Role: VP of HR
Industry: Construction
Company size: 501-1,000 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Bamboo is an easy to use system. It is not the Cadillac of systems but what it does perform, it does well.
Cons: It has limitations. Some of the work flows don't what an HR system should typically do.
Comments: Customer service experience is good. The system functions as promised. It is a good platform for a non-tech savvy demographic.
Reasons for choosing: Ease of use and implementation. The cost of Bamboo was reasonable for our needs as well.
Alternatives considered: Paycom|Arcoro|UKG Pro

Role: Android Developer
Industry: Entertainment
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: What I liked most was how easy it made HR processes without feeling bloated. The interface is intuitive, onboarding and employee record management are straightforward, and payroll/time-off workflows save a lot of admin time. For a small business, having HR, payroll, and hiring in one system was a big advantage. Their applicant tracking and job posting tools also made recruiting more organized. Customer support was responsive when issues came up, and the platform generally felt designed to reduce manual work rather than add complexity. The biggest strength was probably the balance between simplicity and functionality.
Cons: What I liked least was that BambooHR can feel limited once you need more customization or complexity. Reporting can be basic, some workflows feel rigid, and the applicant tracking system can feel too lightweight [truncated]

Role: RBT
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The ease of communicating with employers that worked off site and seeing employees off and return dates.
Cons: The bright green and white combination of the website is straining on my eyes.

Role: IT
Industry: Law Practice
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It's very easy to use for the end user, and it's implementation from a back end perspective was very simple.
Cons: There are some things about the UI that are counterintuitive. Some design decisions with the UI take a little getting used to.
Comments: My overall experience has been very positive. It has been easy to implement and use and outside of some minor issues it's a good platform.
Reasons for switching: I didn't make this choice. So I don't know!
Switched from: ADP Workforce Now

Role: Human Resources
Industry: Telecommunications
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Constant improvements, payroll processing seems simple and easy. I also like the survey and recruitment sections of the platform.
Cons: The state taxes process. There is a lack of follow through with tickets, poas on file get lost and the onus is on the employer to get it, and lastly there is no tracking of tickets with a unique identifier for every request sent to the bamboo tax team. Therefore we get new emails every time with no email trail and end up talking to 5 different people on the same ticket submitted. Also only payroll admins can get updates on tax issues when sometimes there is a separate department within finance who does taxes.
Comments: 3/5. Bamboo is very responsive. However most agents do not seem to know the system well or present solutions.
Reasons for choosing: manager job requisitions are customizable based on [truncated]

Role: College Ministry Staff
Industry: Non-Profit Organization Management
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I have found that Bamboo is simple to use as an employee and it is very accessible to those new to managing their HR.
Cons: I think it would be nice if our retirement accounts were linked so all related HR stuff was in one place.
Comments: Overall my experience is great. I can access what I need to access quickly and without much help needed from our HR personnel.

Role: Patient Care Coordinator
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I love how easy it is to navigate and access information. I have never encountered an issue with this software.
Cons: Occasionally it takes me two tries to login, as if the screen is glitchy.
Comments: BambooHR is easy to use and is visually appealing. It allows me to easily access my Time Off, Timecards, and important dates for other colleagues.

Role: Operator
Industry: Telecommunications
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It is very easy to use, I can find everything in a very easy and simple interface. I like the notifications too. Money to get into my bank does not take too long.
Cons: It takes some time to load but it’s not that much. It can be a bit complicated to find specific information of my contract
Comments: Pretty good, like the design and how easy it is to use. I find it good that the processing time is less than 10 minutes.

Role: Content Creator
Industry: Education Management
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: I appreciate how Deel functions as a central hub for all important documentation and payments, which helps in keeping everything organized and streamlined. It’s very easy to use and has made managing finances and contracts much more efficient for me. The initial setup was also very easy, which eased the transition to using this platform.
Cons: I find that Deel's website could be a little easier to navigate. But other than that it served all the purposes I needed it to.

Role: Senior Web Developer
Industry: Financial Services
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I love Deel because it is one of the few platforms that truly facilitates the lives of global workers. It helps me easily access the money I earn from clients abroad and convert it into my local currency.
Cons: That the physical deel card is not available for my country Colombia; because I think that having it would facilitate me to use it my money o a daily basis.
Comments: I truly believe Deel is a must-use platform if you want to be a global worker. It is the real modern solution for modern problems.

Role: Customer support representative
Industry: Telecommunications
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Deel's platform is user-friendly and offers convenient features like the Deel Card and Deel Advance, ensuring fast and secure transactions
Cons: Inconsistent fee structure across various transfer amounts. Deel provides a reliable platform with room for improvement in fee transparency
Comments: Deel offers a relatively smooth and secure platform with valuable features. However, the fee structure needs improvement to make it more equitable for all users

Role: Legal Assistant
Industry: Legal Services
Company size: 201-500 employees

Ease-of-use rating: 5

Cons: I do not have anything that I did not like yet. Maybe i will with time but nothing at the moment. :)

Role: medical reviewer
Industry: Alternative Medicine

Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Easy to use, can see everything about public holidays, contact, payroll. Some customization and dark mode.
Cons: Sometimes slow to load. Some options you cannot remove. App is sometimes not working correctly but overall good
Comments: Overall it's good, there are some places it can be improved in customization but those are not deal breakers

Role: Business Management Assitant
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The ease of use, and how it was able to give a simple but in depth detail of what I am expecting and need. Really serves its purpose as a platform for Income
Cons: Sometimes having able to get anything, I am not sure what I was really looking for based on the choices available
Comments: So far, all my needs were met.. there's an AI tool as well when it comes to inquiries I am not familiar with yet.

Role: Business Analyst
Industry: Outsourcing/Offshoring
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I really like this service. The platform is intuitive and easy to navigate, and transactions are processed very quickly, which saves a lot of time and makes operations much more efficient.
Cons: I haven’t experienced any significant disadvantages while using this service so far. The platform works reliably, processes transactions quickly, and provides a smooth overall experience without noticeable issues
Comments: One of the best services i've ever tried. So easy to use, fast transactions, wise support. I like it

Role: Customer Success Manager
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I consider Deel to be an ingenious solution for international workers who work as contractors. In general terms, I can say that the interface is easy to use, intuitive, and pleasant. Regarding opportunities for improvement, I think it is important to mention that the web platform is sometimes a bit slow, especially when it comes to the payments and transfers panel, which is why I don't give it a 5/5. Overall, I recommend it as an international payroll platform.
Cons: Now, with regard to the opportunities for improvement that we consider in the case of Deel, the first would be the speed of the web platform, since in several cases and on Windows itself it is somewhat slow and has recurring bugs where it freezes, especially on the transfer platform. The Deel card solution is adequate, but it has quite high fees in [truncated]

Role: Admin and Loan officer
Industry: Accounting
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I liked that Deel makes managing international payments and hiring remote contractors simple and efficient. It saves a lot of time, reduces paperwork, and makes global payroll much easier to handle.
Cons: I didn’t like that some fees can be high, and the platform can be a bit confusing at first when navigating all the features.
Comments: My overall experience with Deel has been positive. It makes hiring and paying remote contractors across different countries much easier and more efficient. While there’s a slight learning curve and some fees can add up, it has streamlined payroll and compliance, saving a lot of time and hassle.
